issuing_body: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT) (文部科学省 高等教育局 専門教育課・大学教育・入試課)
covered_actors: Universities and Colleges of Technology (大学・高等専門学校)
National and public university corporations (国公立大学法人)
Local governments establishing universities or colleges of technology
Incorporated educational institutions under MEXT jurisdiction (文部科学大臣所轄学校法人)
School-establishing companies operating universities (学校設置会社)
National Institute of Technology (独立行政法人国立高等専門学校機構)
Higher-education faculty, staff, and students (教職員・学生)

evidence.quote:
学生がレポート等に生成AI を利活用した場合には、適切に学修成果を評価するた
め、利活用した旨や利活用した生成AI の種類・箇所等を明記させることや、小テスト
や口述試験等を併用するなど評価方法の工夫を行うことも有効と考えられること。
evidence.quote_en: When students utilize generative AI in reports or other outputs, in order to appropriately evaluate learning outcomes, it is considered effective to have them explicitly state that generative AI was used, the type of generative AI used, and the sections where it was used, as well as to devise evaluation methods such as combining quizzes or oral examinations.

evidence.quote:
こうした生成AI に関する技術的限界を把握した上で、インターネット検索等と
同様に、出力された内容の確認・裏付けを行うことが必要と考えられること。
evidence.quote_en: While understanding these technical limitations of generative AI, just as with internet searches, it is considered necessary to verify and corroborate the outputted content.

evidence.quote:
ま
た、AI が生成した文章かを判定するツールを学修成果の評価等に活用する場合でも、
その結果を過信しないことが重要であること。
evidence.source_section: Page 3 (生成AIと学修活動との関係性、成績評価)
evidence.quote_en: Furthermore, even when using tools that detect whether text was generated by AI to evaluate learning outcomes, it is important not to place excessive trust in their results.

evidence.quote:
生成AI への入力を通じ、機密情報や個人情報等が意図せず流出・漏洩する可能性等
があるため、一般的なセキュリティ上の留意点として、機密情報や個人情報等を安易
に生成AI に入力することは避けることが必要と考えられること。なお、特に教職員が
生成AI を利活用する際には、各大学・高専における情報セキュリティに関する指針1
や、個人情報保護法2を踏まえた対応が必要となることに留意すること。
evidence.source_section: Page 4 (機密情報や個人情報の流出・漏洩等の可能性)
evidence.quote_en: Because confidential or personal information may be unintentionally leaked through inputs into generative AI, as a general security precaution it is considered necessary to avoid carelessly entering confidential or personal information into generative AI. In particular, when faculty and staff use generative AI, care must be taken to comply with each university/KOSEN's information security guidelines and the Act on the Protection of Personal Information.

evidence.quote: 大学・高専における生成AI の教学面の取扱いについては、それぞれの教育の実態等に応じ、今後の状況変化を踏まえて指針等の内容を見直すことも含め、主体的に対応いただくことが重要と考えています。
evidence.quote_en: Regarding the handling of generative AI in teaching at universities and colleges of technology, we consider it important for each institution to respond proactively according to its educational circumstances, including revising its guidelines in light of future changes.

evidence.quote: 各大学・高専におかれては、本資料も参考に、引き続き生成AI の取扱いに関して適切な対応を図っていただきますようお願いします。
evidence.quote_en: Each university and college of technology is requested to refer to this document and continue taking appropriate measures regarding the handling of generative AI.

implementation_notes: Official MEXT Higher Education Bureau administrative notice (事務連絡) issued July 13, 2023 (Reiwa 5), providing reference guidance to Japanese universities and colleges of technology (KOSEN) on handling generative AI (particularly text-generating LLMs such as ChatGPT) in teaching, assessment, and university administration. Rather than imposing uniform statutory bans, MEXT asks each institution to formulate and continuously update its own policies, permissible/prohibited use rules, and faculty/staff development (FD/SD) training. Key operational points include discouraging direct submission of unedited AI outputs as student reports, requiring student disclosure of AI usage, verifying outputs for hallucinations/bias, not over-relying on AI-detection tools, avoiding input of confidential/personal data in line with institutional security rules and APPI (noting training opt-out controls where available), respecting Copyright Act limits (including Article 35 classroom exceptions), and participating in MEXT's Mathematics, Data Science, and AI Education accreditation and consortium programs.
